  - [Su et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.10773) use two RCTs, latent CATE transportability, trial-participation positivity, four proxy restrictions, and Proposition 2 explicitly assumes both observed bridge sets H and Q are nonempty. The note supplies only the outcome-difference side, uses an arbitrary network, and observes only (X,W) in its target sample. Its one-edge formula recovers Su’s outcome-bridge algebra, but its class does not satisfy Su’s full published Proposition 2 hypotheses. The comparator phrase “either observed bridge equation” must record Su’s joint nonemptiness premise.
  - [Miao et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.08816) require the categorical proxy matrix P(W∣Z,x) to be invertible, equivalently full latent-category rank in their equal-cardinality setup. The note’s q_x<d example is genuinely outside that guarantee; this comparison is accurate.

Necessity is proved on the tangent-rich subclass. Its two-law counterexample transfers upward to every supermodel containing those same witnesses with the same observed-data map and estimand. Sufficiency does not transfer upward unless the broader class retains the bridge representation.

- There is a material missed graph-rank elbow. Under the rank-one attainable-row model, the proof extends from saturation to

    rank(A_{P,x}) = r_{q_x}(E)

Expand an arbitrary r×r minor by proxy-coordinate blocks: a nonzero monomial is exactly a partition of the selected labeled edges into q forests. Conversely, any q-forest partition supplies a noncancelling minor. Hence connectedness can be dropped, the exceptional locus is cut out by the r_q(E)-minors, and generic global rank is Σ_x r_{q_x}(E).

- This sharpens augmentation materially. For simultaneous saturation across strata, one only needs q_max=max_x q_x and a q_max-tree packing. If the candidate menu is feasible, matroid basis extension implies that a positive-cost minimum augmentation always contains exactly

    q_max(|V|−1) − r_{q_max}(E)

  added labeled edges; the current conditional “whenever the menu contains an extension” caveat is unnecessary. Weighted contraction by a basis of E gives the exact minimum-cost construction.

- Strict positivity of every C_x(w∣u) is also stronger than the lift uses. It suffices that each x have a nonempty active carrier J_x on which C_x(w∣u)>0 for every u and the required outcome-support tangent maps are surjective; choose ρ_x supported on J_x, set d=ρ_x(r_a−r_anchor)/C_x on J_x, and d=0 off J_x.
